wars.outcome: 'The Mongols stormed the city on 30 March 1221 and burned it and killed its inhabitants'; the generals Jebe and Subutai led the conquest; Sulafa Khatun 'was at Ru'in Dez' (Maragheh page). The Ahmadilis page has them ruling 'in Ru'in Dez for some years after the Mongol invasion', so the 1221 sack is not booked as a loss.

certainty.note: Only Maragheh (and the fortress of Ru'in Dez) is named; the 50 km disc is an approximation. The dynasty's start year differs between the Ahmadilis infobox (1122) and the Maragheh page's first appointment (1111/12).

notes:
A state Cliopatria lacks (cliopatria_names []). Two pages opened (Ahmadilis, Maragheh). Wikidata id not obtainable: null.
Dates: the Ahmadilis infobox gives 1122 and 1225; this dossier starts in 1112 on the Maragheh page's explicit sentence about Ahmadil (the dynasty's eponym), and ends in 1225 (infobox; 'In 1231, Mongol rule over Maragheh was made definite' on the Maragheh page). The Ahmadilis page lists Ala al-Din Korpe Arslan and Rukn al-Din (1134-1173) beside Aq Sunqur II (1134-1169), so the ruler strip keeps only the non-overlapping list; the list has a gap 1169-1173.
Territory: Maragheh only. Status: the Ahmadilis 'were Atabegs of the Seljuk Empire' (suzerain-side, undated); the Eldiguz page makes Maragha one of his vassals (eldiguzids notes: undated). The Ahmadilis page also says the Ahmadilis 'ruled ... until 1208-09 in Maragheh itself', which sits against 'The last Ahmadili ruler of Maragheh was Sulafa Khatun (r. 1209-1225)' on the Maragheh page; the 1221 Mongol storm 'burned' the city and the dynasty is booked as continuing at Ru'in Dez to 1225.
Mirrors: rawadid-dynasty, great-seljuk-empire, khwarezmid-empire carry no Maragheh events; the Hulegu dossiers' Maragheh residence from 1258 (Maragheh page) is not recorded here.
Not settled: the 1122/23 dismissal of Aq Sunqur against the list's 1122-1134 reign; Ru'in Dez's location.
Gazetteer names used that it lacks: none.
